text: [Skin type] oily, sensitive, and acne prone. + Seasonal dryness issues 🪾[climate] summer —> fall big temperature gaps through the day, and dry overall **[current routine]** - **day routine**: toner(laneige)-cream(ongridients)-facial mist(aestura)-sun block(aestura) -**night routine**: day routine+isoi acne dr, primera pdrn nia serum *nothing on my routine is scented or colored bc i have very sensitive skin. **Ongridients skin barrier calming lotion** Duaration: 5 months ***9.5/10 (could feel a bit slippery to use on a hot day)*** Using it whenever i feel like my skin barrier is getting weak. (every day, night) How i use it: Whenever my skin starts looking red or feeling rough, I soak a cotton pad with this and leave it on the irritated spot overnight (or before bed). By the next morning, my skin is completely calmed down and back to normal. it went viral in Korea last year Cons**:** Hard to find / not widely available, and rarely goes on good sales. **Primera PDRN-Niacinamide 10% Toning Glow Serum** Duration: 1month_should've got it sooner ***100/10.*** Using it only in the night time, once every 1-2 days. **THE BEST SERUM of the year**- made my skin shiny, and also doesn't irritate your skin either. text: I’m a mixed-race black/white/Latino guy, living in the Seattle area which is a temperate rainforest technically. I have combo dry skin and I was traveling in SE Asia, Germany, Spain, the American SW, so places where I needed sunscreen and was wearing shorts and T-shirts most of the time. Reviews are all copied and pasted below but also in the slides. Biore Uv Aqua Rich Watery Essence 🇯🇵 - 9/10 Absorbs well. Has a bit of a grainy quality but it’s extremely slight. Doesn’t really add moisture to the skin. Fine to reapply during the day and waterproof. Never used on face. Biore Athlizm Spray 🇯🇵 - 6/10 It’s fine, it is just a bad value for the money. The spray evaporates really quickly so it’s hard to tell where you applied it. Must prefer the cream Biore Athlizm Cream 🇯🇵 - 9/10 Really the GOAT for anything outdoor, sweaty or swimming. You feel like a duck with it on. It stuck all day when I was in Singapore or swimming in the hottest days in Seattle. Not an everyday sunscreen, but the best for what it does. Haruharu wonder black rice airyfit 🇰🇷 - 3/10 It piles on the face and body for me. Not waterproof so maybe best in winter. It may have to do with me putting too much on, but despite all the hype around it, wouldn’t buy it again Nivea UV super water gel 🇯🇵 - 8/10 goes on very easily and disappears into the skin. Like the pump that you can refill. Not waterproof so prob best for winter/cooler months. Mediheal Madecassoside moisture sun serum 🇰🇷 - 7/10 Applies as a liquid but absorbs instantly. You don’t need to reapply during the day. Waterproof and pretty much invisible. It does pill like every other Korean sunscreen on me. Wish it didn’t. Holika Holika aloe waterproof sunscreen 🇰🇷 - 9/10 Smells pleasant like aloe vera. Ok to reapply throughout the day without piling. Leaves a very slight white cast in the elbow but that’s about all I can say bad about it. Didn’t use it on my face. House of Hur Weightless 🇰🇷 - 5/10 No smell. Goes on very liquid and disappears with no glow. It seems to pill on the face around the neck but not on the body. Senka UV water Gel 🇯🇵 - 7/10 It goes on a bit sticky but does dry. Leaves a white cast as it has zinc oxide in it. Def feels waterproof. Would use this in hot weather or swimming for sure. No smell. Fine to reapply. Beauty of Joseon Relief Sun Aqua Fresh 🇰🇷 - 5/10 It pills on the face, back of the neck and ears but it’s fine on the body. Feels like lotion on the body so I like that. KISS ME MOMMY! UV Aqua Milk Sunscreen SPF50+ PA++++ 🇯🇵 - 8/10 It’s waterproof, it dissolves into the skin, it’s great for the face. It does pill a little bit on my neck when I reapplied. It has no scent and it’s mild enough to use on a 1 year old baby. SCINIC Enjoy Super Mild Sun Essence 🇰🇷 - 8/10 Great on first application, but it does pile on second application after a while. No white cast. No smell. Very light. Not waterproof. Does pile less than some others, will try applying less. Really want to love this one! Nivea UV Super Water Essence EX 🇯🇵 - 9/10 Wonderful smell. Goes on like a creamy gel then disappears. Fine to reapply. Love it! Fine on face, but it is pretty shiny. Skin Aqua Super Moisture UV Gel 🇯🇵 - 10/10 Great on face or body. Fine to reapply without pilling as it is a fine gel-like cream. Not too shiny. Waterproof. Very moisturizing ingredient list so works as a lotion. Might be perfect. Biore Aqua Rich Watery Gel 🇯🇵 1/10 - Has titanium dioxide which immediately made me look sickly white. It also pills up on the skin after first application with no other product underneath. I thought I couldn’t dislike any Japanese sunscreen but here I am. Nivea Deep Protect & Care gel 🇯🇵 - 8/10 Feels very moisturizing on my skin. I like the scent but it does smell like mosquito repellent when you put it on. Don’t know if I’m going to try it on face for that reason. Feels like I have nothing on after applying. Really good body sunscreen. Biore UV Aqua Rich Airy Hold Cream 🇯🇵 - 5/10 Goes on very thick, like soft serve ice cream or Greek yogurt. At first it leaves a white tint, but you can rub it in. It doesn’t feel moisturizing per se but def feels like it’s sticking to your skin. Has titanium dioxide so I don’t think I’d use it on my face. I’ll use it up on my body but wouldn’t buy again. Nivea UV Super Water Gel Ex 🇯🇵 - 10/10 Big ass bottle at 270g. Good deals on Yami. Goes on matte. Fine to reapply. Need to try on face. Tage Cica-Tree Water Jelly Sun Serum 🇰🇷 - 6/10 It’s ok. It does pill a little around the folds of my neck upon reapplication, but that’s it. It goes on a bit shiny. The consistency is a bit chunky so it doesn’t come out of the tube consistently. It can come out a lot at once and it’s impossible to avoid. Wouldn’t buy again. Nivea Men Uv Protector 🇯🇵 - 4/10 Too small. Smells funny. Pills on me on first application. Kose Suncut Uv Perfect Essence 🇯🇵 - 7/10 Great size. Really moisturizing. Goes into skin and beard well. It does pill a little around my neck after reapplication. Great ingredients like Squalane and other soothing extracts. Hatomugi UV care and moisturizing spf 50+ 🇯🇵 - 9/10 Big bottle. Very pleasant feeling and smell on the skin. Seemed fine on face. Doesn’t seem to be waterproof but great for daily use. Nivea UV Super Water Essence Ex 🇯🇵 - 10/10 Really just as good as the gel. Slightly more moisturizing and a little less product for the money. Regardless, you put it on and a second later you’d never know it was on your face. Can reapply all day without pilling
